tasks.title: Source prompt builder
tasks.detail: Turns pasted source into a structured WAKE frame with role, objective, scenes, hooks, constraints, and output contract.

tasks.title: Local rule content agent
tasks.detail: Generates deterministic hooks, captions, titles, and platform blocks locally. This is not a cloud LLM claim.

tasks.title: Snapshot storage
tasks.detail: Saves the current source, output, runtime status, and capability map to server/data/snapshots.

tasks.title: Task monitor scaling
tasks.detail: Bounded, searchable, filterable task surface so the list does not grow forever.

tasks.title: Content Cluster organizer
tasks.detail: Builds local source themes, output lanes, proof notes, and operator-ready handoff drafts without dispatching externally.

tasks.title: RUNE validation attach
tasks.detail: RUNE is recognized as an external/Drive-linked operator lane. It is not wired into this V6 runtime yet.

tasks.title: LOOM orchestration attach
tasks.detail: LOOM is recognized as an external/Drive-linked operator lane. It is not wired into this V6 runtime yet.

tasks.title: ECHO memory attach
tasks.detail: Blocked until a real memory/vector database connection is selected and verified.

tasks.title: Viral Brothers bridge
tasks.detail: ViralForge Brothers live in Viral Forge. V6 does not call that app until an explicit bridge contract exists.

capabilities.label: Ingest & Parse
capabilities.detail: Accepts pasted source text and turns it into structured frame fields.

capabilities.label: Local Content Agent
capabilities.detail: Deterministic local pack generation. No fake AI provider claim.

capabilities.label: Content Cluster
capabilities.detail: Locally groups source into content pillars, output lanes, proof notes, and operator-ready handoff drafts.

capabilities.label: Snapshot Storage
capabilities.detail: Writes auditable JSON snapshots to the local repo runtime folder.

capabilities.label: Script & Structure
capabilities.detail: Frames scenes, hooks, captions, and CTAs. Long-form timing is not attached.

capabilities.label: Distribution
capabilities.detail: Platform exports require a Viral Forge or hosted publishing bridge.

capabilities.label: Learning Memory
capabilities.detail: Requires a verified database/vector-store connection before it can be called live.
